name: head
summary: Shows the beginning of a file.
description: Shows the first lines (10 by default) of each file. Very useful at the end of a pipe to limit long output.

options.description: Number of lines to show. With a minus sign (-n -5), shows everything except the last 5.
Number of bytes to show instead of lines.
Does not print the “==> file <==” header with several files.
Always prints the header with the file name.

example.output:
==> notes.txt <==
Meeting on Monday
Call Sara

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to read. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: The first 10 lines of a file.
